params.echoOutputHighLevel: 5 V TTL, equal to the 5 V supply: needs a divider or level shifter before a 3.3 V GPIO

provenance.notes: KIT: no ultrasonic lesson or part in the SunFounder Basic Starter Kit table of contents or Component List photo, so 'not in kit'. PIN ORDER: the Elecfreaks HC-SR04 datasheet (SparkFun-hosted copy) prints 'Vcc Trig Echo GND' for the four pins and the SunFounder photo shows a 4-pin male header with the same silkscreen (Vcc, Trig, Echo, Gnd), so Dupont male-female leads go female end onto the module. SUPPLY: the datasheet 'Electric Parameter' table gives Working Voltage DC 5 V and Working Current 15 mA, with no tolerance range, so vccMinV and vccMaxV are both 5. ECHO LEVEL (important): the datasheet says only 'Echo Output Signal: Input TTL lever signal and the range in proportion', with the module powered from 5 V; it prints no voltage number for ECHO. The 5 V level is therefore an inference from the 5 V TTL supply, confirmed by two tutorials that state it outright: wiki.e-yantra.org ('ECHO outputs 5V. Use a voltage divider (1kOhm + 2kOhm) to bring it down to 3.3V before connecting to the Pi GPIO') and pimylifeup.com ('the HC-SR04 outputs at 5V which can damage the Raspberry Pi'). This is why ECHO needs a divider or level shifter before a 3.3 V GPIO (SPEC 8 OVERVOLTAGE_GPIO, SPEC 13.1 ultrasonic assertion). TRIGGER: datasheet 'Trigger Input Signal: 10uS TTL pulse' and 'IO trigger for at least 10us high level'; the module then sends eight 40 kHz pulses; distance = echo high time x 340 m/s / 2, or us / 58 = cm; use a measurement cycle over 60 ms (SunFounder repeats this). The datasheet gives no TRIG input threshold voltage, so none is recorded. RANGE: 2 cm to 400 cm, accuracy to 3 mm, measuring angle 15 degrees; the datasheet lists 'Working Frequency 40Hz', which is a typo for the 40 kHz burst (the same sheet says 40 kHz in the principle text). SIZE: 'Dimension 45*20*15mm' from the datasheet. The transducer diameter and spacing are measured from the SunFounder photo using the 45 mm board length as the scale (+-1 mm) and are stored under 'Approx' keys. The datasheet's attention note says to connect GND first when hot-plugging.
